headline: Fennelun
title: Fennelun | Moon Light Build | Aniimo Guide
video_script: Fennelun is a stage three Light Aniimo with a moonlit fox look, and it even has an Alpha boss form. Lumin Bolts fires three Light missiles and applies a Fox Mark that lowers Light resistance. Moon Impact drops a full moon for power forty five, and hits harder against marked targets. Lunar Eclipse adds heavy extra Break damage. Ready to try it? Comment below!

scenes.sub: Power forty five, bonus on Fox Mark

description: Aniimo Fennelun build: a stage 3 Light Aniimo. Lumin Bolts applies Fox Mark, Moon Impact (power 45) hits marked targets harder and Lunar Eclipse adds heavy Break damage. Checked on aniimo.gg and Aniimo Wiki.
